faqs.question: What are your rates?
faqs.answer: Rates depend on project scope. Small fixes start at $100-300. Full projects range from $500-$5,000+. I always provide a fixed-price quote before starting - no hourly surprises. Monthly retainers are available for ongoing work.

faqs.question: How long does a typical project take?
faqs.answer: Small fixes and security assessments: 1-5 days. Backend APIs and web apps: 2-4 weeks. Android apps: 3-6 weeks. You'll get an accurate estimate after our discovery call.

faqs.question: Do you work hourly or fixed-price?
faqs.answer: I prefer fixed-price projects with clearly defined deliverables. For ongoing work or consulting, I offer hourly or monthly retainer options. We'll agree on the model that works best.

faqs.question: Can you sign an NDA?
faqs.answer: Yes. I regularly work with sensitive banking systems and am comfortable signing NDAs. Your code and data stay yours.

faqs.question: Do you work remotely?
faqs.answer: Yes. I'm based in Bogura, Bangladesh, but I work with clients globally and am available during overlapping hours with US, EU, and APAC timezones.

faqs.question: What happens after delivery?
faqs.answer: You get full ownership of all code. I include a 2-week post-delivery support period for bug fixes, plus optional monthly maintenance after that.
